verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents issuing API tokens or credentials with permission scopes or least-privilege limits. The closest item is the MCP connection's optional org/project scoping, which only sets tool defaults and hides discovery tools. That is an adjacent control, not a scoped credential, and the MCP config reuses the CLI login rather than a dedicated scoped token.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
